available_observables.text: Block temperatures every 30 seconds, maximum during minutes 5-15 and any 55 C abort.
Simultaneous inlet, outlet and ambient readings; calculate inlet-minus-ambient and outlet-minus-inlet with sensor limits.
Fan commands every 30 seconds, commanded on-time and threshold transitions; command does not measure airflow.
Sound at fixed times and distance, with unpowered background before each trial.
Power readings and sketched sheet/sink placement. Reverse order across paired trials; start with block within 1 C of ambient.

causal_return_path_hypothesis: Unobserved hypothesis: outlet air returns to the nearby inlet, raises inlet temperature, reduces cooling and prolongs thermostat-commanded fan operation, sustaining outlet discharge. Test outlet separation present/absent at fixed maximum duty first, then under O7, holding power and probe positions fixed. Existing temperatures do not establish recirculation or feedback.

hard_constraints.text: Use the 120 x 80 x 60 mm enclosure and specified bench parts; no purchases or powered refrigeration.
Outcome trials hold heater input at 6.0 W within 0.2 W; 3.0 W is a diagnostic control only.
Ambient starts between 25 and 28 C. Abort heating above 55 C block temperature; cool unpowered between trials.
A probe has at most four 15-minute heating trials within two hours including cooling and setup.
Changes remain removable and leave cable access open. The thermal target applies only to this mockup.

observations.text: Synthetic geometry: a 40 mm fan draws through an inlet; the side outlet center is 30 mm from the inlet center.
At 6.0 W, fixed 100 percent fan duty and 26.0 C ambient, block temperatures at minutes 5, 10 and 15 are 43.8, 46.3 and 47.2 C.
Same-run inlet temperatures are 28.1, 31.0 and 32.0 C; outlet temperatures are 33.0, 35.8 and 36.7 C.
A separate 3.0 W maximum-speed run ends at 36.5 C block and 27.4 C inlet after 15 minutes, with 26.0 C ambient.
Baseline sound is 46 dBA at 0.5 m; unpowered bench background is 32 dBA at that position.
Boundary anomaly: a stationary cardboard sheet 20 mm beside the outlet changes minute-15 inlet temperature to 34.0 C. Its block temperature is unrecorded.
Existing thermostat rule commands 100 percent duty above 44 C, zero below 42 C and retains the prior command between thresholds. No controlled trace is supplied.

parent_operations.text: Remove heat through fan-driven inlet-to-outlet airflow; duty and external outlet geometry can be examined independently.
Transfer block heat through the removable thermal pad and sink. The exposed block face interfaces conductive cooling with airflow cooling.

preferred_dependency: The operator treats continuous maximum-speed fan operation as necessary for the thermal target. Only one full-load configuration has a complete trace, leaving necessity questionable.

resources.text: Stipulated bench equipment: secured resistive dummy heater, enclosure, fused adjustable DC supply and inline power meter; 3.0 W and 6.0 W are available settings.
40 mm fan and manual PWM controller with 0, 50 and 100 percent settings; an operator can implement O7 every 30 seconds.
Four thermocouples labeled block, inlet, outlet and ambient, with stated 0.5 C accuracy and four-channel display; readings can be recorded manually every 30 seconds.
Sound meter with 1 dBA resolution, fixed stand at 0.5 m and timer; three 10-second readings are feasible at minutes 5, 10 and 15. Calibration is unspecified.
Two 100 x 100 mm cardstock sheets, removable tape, scissors and ruler permit external outlet-air separation or redirection without touching heater or blades.
Removable 40 x 40 x 10 mm aluminum sink, reusable thermal pad, notebook and two-hour bench slot.
Smoke tracer, airflow meter, acoustic spectrum analyzer and environmental chamber are absent; direct flow-field measurements are unavailable.

unknowns.text: Airflow, recirculated fraction and actual speed response to PWM are unmeasured.
Placement bias and ambient drift may explain inlet warming; outlet separation may alter resistance.
Cooling beyond 15 minutes and behavior in real electronics remain conditional.

valued_outcome: Synthetic bench exercise: keep a 6 W dummy electronics block at or below 48 C during minutes 5-15, while reducing fan sound relative to maximum-speed operation. Intermittent or zero fan operation may qualify. No real performance or human benefit is claimed.
